_comment: The set of non-test source files whose contents determine how many
bytes a route pulls from PostgREST. docs/perf-trace-results.json records a
fingerprint over exactly these files at measurement time; scripts/verify-perf-artifact.js
recomputes it at verification time and FAILS CLOSED when they differ.
This exists because the committed artifact was found to be a recording of REVERTED
code: it contained `sets.limit=50` and `limit=25` (the rejected Defects 2 and 3),
which the source can no longer emit, and the verification command read it and
returned EXIT 0 while two routes were live over the ceiling.
Add a file here whenever a new query starts contributing to a measured route.
